generalAbilities.name: Hears Heartbeats
generalAbilities.description: The banshee can hear heartbeats within 60 feet of it as an imprecise sense.

generalAbilities.name: Sunlight Powerlessness
generalAbilities.description: A banshee in sunlight is Clumsy 2 and Stunned 2.

defensiveAbilities.name: Spectral Ripple
defensiveAbilities.description: When a banshee Strides at least 10 feet, they're Concealed until the start of their next turn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Terrifying Touch
offensiveAbilities.description: A creature damaged by the banshee's touch that isn't already frightened must attempt a DC 38 Will Saving Throw save (DC 43 Will Saving Throw if the attack was a critical hit). If the creature fails its save, it's Frightened 2; on a critical failure, the creature also cowers with fear and is Stunned 4. If the creature is protected against fear by a spell or magic item, the banshee's touch first attempts to counteract the protection effect, with the effect of a 9th-rank Dispel Magic spell.

offensiveAbilities.name: Vengeful Spite
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A foe critically hits the banshee, or the banshee critically fails their save against a foe's damaging effect

Effect The banshee lashes back at their tormentor, dealing (4d10+14) Mental Damage damage with a Basic DC 38 Will Saving Throw save and applying the effects of terrifying touch based on the results of the same Will save.

offensiveAbilities.name: Wail
offensiveAbilities.description:
The banshee unleashes a soul-chilling Wails of the Damned (DC 38 Fortitude Saving Throw, 8d10 Void Damage). This Wail overcomes silence and similar effects of 5th rank or lower. The banshee can instead use Wail as a three-action activity to overcome such effects of up to 8th rank.

The banshee's Wail resonates for 1 round, and any creature that comes within the area during that time must attempt a save against the effect. A creature can't be affected more than once by the same Wail. The banshee can't Wail again for 1d4 #recharge wail rounds.
